purpose: Describe a noun using a な-adjective.
keywords: な-adjective + な + noun; predicate + だ / です.
I am looking for a quiet room.
formation: な-adjective + な + noun; predicate + だ / です.
restrictions: な appears before a modified noun, rather than before every predicate.
mistake: Use 静かな部屋 but 部屋は静かです.
